The run aimed to identify spam e-mails from word, character, and capital-letter frequencies. It compared regularized linear, tree-ensemble, and support-vector approaches using stratified validation. A histogram gradient-boosted tree was verified and delivered, with its final test ROC AUC reported as 0.9812.
